body:
Deal: 50% off Property Risk Reports for NSW, VIC, SA, TAS, ACT, BNE: Buyer $14.50 (Was $29), Renter $9.50 (Was $19) @ PropertyFlags

[Jikx] It all keeps tumbling down tumbling down tumbling down..
[pyramid] The PropertyFlags website and reports are operated and provided by Piril Kugu Iscan Gurcaglar (sole trader), ABN 23 142 520 951, NSW, Australia. Prices are shown in AUD. No GST is charged; the provider is not registered for GST, and receipts are not tax invoices.
[PropertyFlags] All correct, and it is on our terms page for exactly this reason. One person, reading government registers so you do not have to. And since no GST is charged, the price you see is the whole price.
[PropertyFlags] Fair catch. Me and the software. I write the replies, it reads the registers, and between us we feel plural.
[Willyslicks] You mean what we can already see from a sec32?
[PropertyFlags] Fair question. Three differences. A section 32 is Victoria only and this covers six states. It arrives at contract stage, prepared by the vendor's side, after you are already emotionally committed; this runs at shortlist stage on any address you are still comparing. And the scope is different: a section 32 covers title, planning overlays and permits, but not serious defect orders, crime statistics, noise exposure, school catchments or connectivity. The sample reports on the site show exactly what is and is not included, free.
[Big L] Section 32s don't include everything and that's why you get conveyancing and a solicitor. Even then, they can stuff it up.
[PropertyFlags] Agreed completely. Nothing here replaces conveyancing or a solicitor, and the report says so on its own pages. The point is walking into their office with the right questions already in hand, before you have paid anyone anything.
